scope: opening-loop candidate detector only: duplicate-face, directed-incidence, degenerate-face and non-convex-loop refusal
delivery: one fix commit on this branch pushed without force; the fix commit SHA is not written here to avoid self-reference

untouched: package.json / lockfile / UI / API / Worker / shared docs

implementedBehavior.duplicateFace: unordered vertex triple is keyed; same-winding duplicates -> OPENING_LOOP_DUPLICATE_FACE, reversed duplicates -> OPENING_LOOP_DUPLICATE_FACE_REVERSED; both refused
implementedBehavior.directedIncidence: each undirected edge keeps a directed traversal sum; incidence 2 with the same traversal direction -> OPENING_LOOP_EDGE_DIRECTION_CONFLICT (unless the pair is the already-reported duplicate face)
implementedBehavior.degenerateFace: zero-area (collinear) or non-finite triangle -> OPENING_LOOP_DEGENERATE_TRIANGLE, checked before any loop
implementedBehavior.closedShell: true only when boundaryEdgeCount is 0 AND no face/edge defect exists
implementedBehavior.componentContract: rejection is per triangle component connected by shared undirected edges; a loop whose bounded component carries any defect is refused with OPENING_LOOP_UNHEALTHY_COMPONENT and the underlying code in detail
implementedBehavior.nonConvex: candidates must be planar, convex and non-self-intersecting; non-convex loop -> OPENING_LOOP_NONCONVEX, self-intersection is checked first
implementedBehavior.identity: canonical cycle, original node ids and triangle indices retained; exact-coordinate seams still refused; no distance welding; outward stays 'undetermined'
